description: Agent-based social influence and policy-driven adoption model on a dynamic small-world network. Individuals decide daily whether to adopt a behavior based on peer influence, marketing, and policy incentives/mandates. Communication diffuses information across the network; the network rewires slowly with homophily.

modules.name: SocialNetworkFormation
modules.description: Initializes and dynamically rewires the social network with homophily.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  create WS graph with N nodes, average degree=network_ws_k, rewire prob=network_ws_p_rewire
  assign nodes to agents 1..N
else:
  for each node i:
    with probability network_dynamic_rewire_rate:
      if degree(i) > 0:
        pick neighbor j uniformly from neighbors(i)
        remove edge (i, j)
      candidate_pool = nodes not connected to i and not i
      score(u) = network_homophily_weight * similarity(i, u) + (1 - network_homophily_weight) * random_uniform()
      pick u* = argmax score(u) subject to degree(u) < network_max_degree
      add edge (i, u*)
update and emit adjacency and degree arrays
notes: similarity uses cosine over standardized attributes: age bucket, income z-score, group one-hot, openness.
Ensure graph stays simple and undirected.
Homophily weight 0 -> random rewiring; 1 -> purely homophilous.

modules.name: CommunicationDynamics
modules.description: Simulates daily message transmission along edges and maintains exposure memories.

notes: Independent cascade style with per-day contact budget capped by comm_max_exposures_per_day.
Memory is a decayed scalar exposure score per agent.

modules.name: PolicyIntervention
modules.description: Generates daily policy and marketing signals (mandates, incentives, outreach).

update_rule.pseudocode:
policy_active = (t >= policy_mandate_start_day) and (t <= policy_mandate_end_day)
incentive = policy_incentive_amount if policy_active else 0.0
contacts_by_agent = zeros(N)
expected_contacts = int(round(marketing_budget_daily))
for c in 1..expected_contacts:
  pick agent i uniformly at random
  if Bernoulli(marketing_contact_probability) == 1:
    contacts_by_agent[i] += 1
emit policy_active, incentive, contacts_by_agent
notes: Marketing contacts are modeled as Bernoulli-thinned uniform targeting.
Mandate window is fixed and can be treated as exogenous.

modules.name: BehaviorAdoption
modules.description: Agent decision-making to adopt or drop the behavior based on social, marketing, and policy signals.

update_rule.pseudocode:
new_adopts = 0; dropouts = 0
for each agent i:
  peer_adopt_frac = mean(adopted[neighbors(i)]) if degree(i) > 0 else 0
  social_reinforce = adoption_social_reinforcement * max(0, peer_adopt_frac - adoption_threshold_mean)
  marketing_signal = log(1 + contacts_by_agent[i])
  policy_signal = (1.0 if policy_active else 0.0)
  utility = adoption_base_rate
  utility += adoption_peer_weight * peer_adopt_frac
  utility += adoption_marketing_weight * marketing_signal
  utility += adoption_policy_weight * policy_signal
  utility += social_reinforce
  utility -= adoption_stubborn_resistance * stubborn[i]
  utility -= adoption_fatigue_decay * max(0, t - last_adoption_change_day[i]) / 30.0
  # threshold heterogeneity
  effective_threshold = Normal(adoption_threshold_mean, adoption_threshold_std) truncated to [0,1] per agent at init
  # probabilistic choice via logistic temperature
  p_adopt = sigmoid((utility - effective_threshold) / max(1e-6, adoption_temperature))
  if adopted[i] == False:
    if Bernoulli(p_adopt) == 1:
      adopted[i] = True; new_adopts += 1; last_adoption_change_day[i] = t
  else:
    # reversion allowed when no policy or weak enforcement
    reversion_p = adoption_reversion_prob * (1.0 - policy_enforcement_probability * (1.0 if policy_active else 0.0))
    if Bernoulli(min(1.0, max(0.0, reversion_p))) == 1:
      adopted[i] = False; dropouts += 1; last_adoption_change_day[i] = t
emit adopted flags, new_adoptions_today=new_adopts, dropouts_today=dropouts
notes: Combines threshold and random utility via logistic transformation.
Marketing signal saturates with log(1 + contacts).

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates and reports daily observables (rates, cumulative counts). Applies optional smoothing.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(adopted_flags)
if t == 0: cumulative_adopters = sum(adopted_flags)
else: cumulative_adopters = previous_cumulative + new_adoptions_today - dropouts_today
exposure_rate = mean(exposures_today)
exposure_rate_smoothed = moving_average(exposure_rate, window=agg_smoothing_window_days)
emit adoption_rate_daily, cumulative_adopters, exposure_rate_daily_smoothed
notes: Cumulative counts reflect net new adopters minus dropouts.
Smoothing uses a simple trailing window average.

algorithms.NetworkGeneration: Watts-Strogatz small-world with dynamic homophilous rewiring.
algorithms.InformationDiffusion: Independent cascade with degree bias and saturation.
algorithms.AdoptionDecision: Random utility with logistic choice and heterogeneous thresholds.
algorithms.Smoothing: Trailing moving average over specified window.
